about: Yaarbro's swimming clips, made by tools/meshy-rig-animate.mjs. The rig is Meshy's default skeleton, the same his other Meshy files have. tread, surface and climb_out come from Meshy's animation library; underwater was made from these words with Text to Motion, because the library has no underwater swim.

motions.name: underwater
motions.prompt: A person swims underwater with the body stretched out level and face down, doing a slow, steady breaststroke: arms sweep forward together, out and back to the sides, while the legs do a frog kick, then a short glide. Smooth and calm, staying in place, loops cleanly.
